profile.summary: A Berkeley-based nonprofit, known as BORP, that offers adaptive sports, fitness and recreation programs for people with mobility and vision disabilities. Programs include wheelchair basketball, rugby, power soccer, goalball, cycling, kayaking and fitness classes, in person and online.
